marketLeader.title: Become Market Leader
marketLeader.description: Conquer the largest market share by 1992

step1.title: Develop hardware
step1.description: Pick CPU, RAM, graphics, sound, storage and a matching case. Each build takes 1-2 quarters and costs money.

step2.title: Allocate budgets
step2.description: Marketing, Development, Research and Support each have their own budget — spend wisely.

step3.title: Hire staff
step3.description: Engineers, marketers, researchers and support staff speed up and amplify each area.

step4.title: Secure financing
step4.description: Running low on cash? Take a bank loan or pitch a VC for growth capital.

step5.title: Close quarters
step5.description: Watch sales, market share and competitor moves — then adjust your strategy.

hardware.title: 🛠️ Hardware Development
hardware.intro: Every computer is a mix of components. The right combination decides who buys.

tip.title: Tip
tip.description: Higher development budget and more engineers = shorter dev time. Custom chips from research give a long-term edge.

marketing.title: Marketing
marketing.description: Directly drives sales. More marketing = more reach and brand awareness.

development.title: Development
development.description: Speeds up hardware builds. Double the budget ≈ twice as fast.

research.title: Research
research.description: Raises the chance of unlocking custom chips per quarter. Researchers amplify the effect.

support.title: Support
support.description: Cuts returns, lifts satisfaction and protects your reputation as the customer base grows.

staff.title: 👥 Staff & Roles
staff.intro: In the Management tab you build a team from 4 roles. Each role boosts one budget area.
staff.tip: Salaries are paid every quarter — only hire what you can afford.

financing.title: 🏦 Financing
financing.intro: Three ways to raise capital when cash gets tight:

options.bootstrap: Bootstrap — grow from your own revenue. Full control, slow pace.
options.loan: Bank loan — fixed annuity, predictable, but defaulting can end the game.
options.vc: Venture capital — pitch a VC. Big cash injection in exchange for equity.

warning.title: ⚠️ Warning!
warning.description: You start with limited capital and recurring costs (salaries, rent, budgets). Without profitable sales or financing you'll go bankrupt — watch your cash flow!

competitors.title: 🏆 Your Competition
competitors.intro: Four AI rivals compete for the same market. They react to your pricing and innovations.
